content:
Looking at the proof:

1. We need to prove `P.Nonempty(s + t)`
2. `P.FromPositive` requires `S.Size(s + t) > 0` and proves `P.Nonempty(s + t)`
3. `S.LengthConcat` proves `S.Size(s + t) == S.Size(s) + S.Size(t)`
4. We know `S.Size(s) > 0` from precondition

So the steps are:
- Call `S.LengthConcat(s, t)` to establish `S.Size(s + t) == S.Size(s) + S.Size(t)`, which combined with `S.Size(s) > 0` gives `S.Size(s + t) > 0`
- Call `P.FromPositive(s + t)` to conclude `P.Nonempty(s + t)`

```dafny
include "SequenceFacts.dfy"
include "SequenceProperties.dfy"
module Client {
  import S = SequenceFacts
  import P = SequenceProperties
  lemma AppendKeepsNonempty(s: seq<int>, t: seq<int>)
    requires S.Size(s) > 0
    ensures P.Nonempty(s + t)
  {
    S.LengthConcat(s, t);
    P.FromPositive(s + t);
  }
}
```
